title: Track2Art: Articulated Object Model Recovery with Visual-Geometric Track Representations
authors: X. Li∗, **Y. Jing∗**, J. Ding, W. Li, B. Busam, G. Wang†, B. Sheil
tldr: Uses visual-geometric tracks from RGB-D interaction videos to discover rigid parts and recover kinematic relations, joint types, and joint axes.

media.alt: Track2Art demonstration of articulated object part segmentation and joint-axis recovery from tracked motion in interaction videos.
